messages:
mira: Heads-up: we need a recompute of user_agg.calls_1m for last 9 days due to a late-ingest gap from the EU collector (partitions 2024-04-12..2024-04-21). This will touch ~1.2TB of aggregate state. Plan below — need ops + observability signoff before we run Friday 23:00 UTC. TL;DR: canary 3% tenants -> staggered shards -> dry-run -> atomic swap.

jamal: +1. important to avoid dashboard spikes and duplicate counts. A few asks:
- How are we ensuring idempotency on upsert? recompute_id?
- KV cache invalidation plan?
- Quota/concurrency per-tenant?

sophie: I'll handle Grafana alert suppression. We should add a temporary mute on the alert rule and annotate the dashboard. Suggest +1h margin around the run.

mira: Answers:
- recompute will write to staging table telemetry_agg_staging_{run_id} then swap using a single upsert:

```sql
INSERT INTO telemetry_agg (tenant_id, window_start, count, updated_at)
SELECT tenant_id, window_start, count, now()
FROM telemetry_agg_staging_{run_id}
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, window_start) DO UPDATE
SET count = EXCLUDED.count, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
WHERE telemetry_agg.count <> EXCLUDED.count;
```

This keeps it idempotent and avoids unnecessary writes.

- We'll add recompute_id uuid to staging rows and to migrate-run metadata; runner marks completed shards.

- KV cache: jamal, can we add a debounce window for prefix invalidation? i'd prefer not to tombstone the whole tenant cache. plan: call kv.invalidate(prefix) for affected windows + bump TTL for 2m to force reads fallback.

leo: For concurrency/quota, propose per-tenant concurrency=2, global concurrency=64, throttle by tenant QPS. Backfill runner config:

```bash
backfill-runner --job telemetry-recompute --run-id=202404-recompute-01 \
  --shards=128 --concurrency=64 --per-tenant=2 --dry-run
```

mira: We'll do a canary on 3% of tenants (random sample) with dry-run first: runs write only to staging and generate metrics about delta. If deltas > 0.5% for any tenant we abort and debug.

jamal: for routing: please ensure recompute traffic uses the 'batch-heavy' capacity pool (dedicated nodes) so we don't evict latency-critical inference workloads. Add policy: route by tag 'backfill' -> pool=dedicated-batch; fallback to spot if quota exceeded.

mira: done, added route policy in config: route.policy = { "tag": "backfill", "preferred_pool": "dedicated-batch", "fallback": "spot-batch" }

sophie: I'll post the temporary alert mute and add dashboard annotation. Also suggest we add a synthetic check to validate totals post-swap: compare sum(telemetry_agg) vs sum(staging) within 0.1%.

leo: small nit: make sure the job marks processed event_id ranges to avoid reprocessing same events later. use checkpoints: (partition, max_event_seq).

jamal: agree. Also capture a sample of raw events for any tenant where delta > 1% for manual audit.

deploy-bot: backfill-runner queued: job=telemetry-recompute run_id=202404-recompute-01 shards=128 estimated_duration=2h

mira: schedule: dry-run canary Fri 23:00 UTC -> validate Sat 02:00 UTC -> full-staggered run Sat 04:00-10:00 UTC with shard rolling every 5m. Owners: jamal (runner), mira (coord), sophie (observability), leo (ops).

jamal: I'll prep the runbook and pre-flight checklist. one more ask: can we expose a small readonly console flag so PMs can see 'recompute status' in the UI? it'd be helpful.

mira: yes, will add endpoint /internal/recompute/status and a console badge. internal-only.

sophie: thumbs up. I'll create the grafana annotation and mute rule now.

leo: will monitor node pressure and GPU usage. plan to autoscale batch pool up to x3 during run.

mira: thanks everyone. if no blockers we'll run Fri 23:00 UTC. react :thumbsup: if you are good with this plan.
